question: PHPStan remains failing after the second bounded repair attempt; should this slice resume for one additional in-scope annotation/test-analysis repair?
why_now: The first run exposed resolver and test discovery typing issues; the repair removed one narrowing issue and added the return shape, but the second run now reports error-return shape mismatches, test null-coalescing, and pre-existing TestHarness iterable annotations. The standing contract mandates an L4 stop after the second failed repair attempt on the same gate.

options.label: Allow one additional bounded repair
options.effect: Adjust resolver result shape annotation and analyze the test with an appropriate PHPStan discovery mechanism
options.blast_radius: Four changed files and PHPStan invocation only

options.label: Keep the mandatory stop
options.effect: Leave the current implementation and report blocked pending a later run

recommendation.rationale: Option 'resume' best preserves the approved task boundary.

impact_of_no_decision: The bounded run remains stopped until the director answers.

resolution.note: Authorise one bounded repair; fix the declared return shape, do not touch the baseline.
